To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the free field approach of the SL(2,R) WZW model with level k=9/ 4 reproduces the metric of the black hole found by Dijkraaf et al., that the tachyon scattering amplitudes can be computed and that the connection to the matrix model is established.

the SL(2,R) gauged free field theory of Bershadsky-Kutasov is an exact CFT describing the two-dimensional black hole for k=9 and that this CFT reproduces the metric, the dilaton and the tachyon scattering in the mini-supespace approximation.
The SL(2, R)/U(1), k= 9/4, WZW model is an exact CFT describing a black hole.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a better understanding of the string theory description of black holes.
the construction of a two-dimensional black hole model and with the calculation of the scattering amplitude of the massless excitations of this model.
the construction of a conformal field theory for a two-dimensional black hole.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the free field description of the SL(2,R) WZW model is a very powerful tool to compute physical quantities in the black hole.
the SL(2,R) gauged CFT with k=9/ 4 is an exact CFT description of the black hole in two-dimensions.
the free field approach of this CFT is a useful and efficient tool in order to compute physical quantities of this black-hole model.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the free field approach of the SL(2,R) gauged CFT gives the correct results for the physical quantities of the black hole and that the deformed matrix models of Jevick and Yoneya are related to this CFT.
the SL(2,R) / U(1) WZW model is an exactly solvable model of a two-dimensional black hole.
the SL(2,R) WZW model is an exactly solvable black hole model.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the black hole background in the CFT is a very natural deformation of the c=1 theory.
the free field approach is a powerful tool in order to study black hole physics.
the free field formulation of Bershadsky-Kutasov is an exact CFT description of the black hole and that this CFT is a useful tool to analyse the black hole background.
